text:
julian (Partnerships): FYI LunarGrid asked to be listed in ms-orchid-1 marketplace with dedicated capacity. They want 16 H100-equivalent GPUs reserved + private VPC + BYOK KMS. Launch target 2026-05-12.

 tomas (LunarGrid): Correct. Soft launch only for EU customers initially. Baseline need is 8 reserved nodes for 4 tenants (2 GPUs/tenant) and burst up to 16 for peak. Low-latency inference is critical.

 nora (Cloud Ops): Can we get exact SKU names and whether partner requires non-preemptible? Also need to know if they require static IPs for egress.

 tomas (LunarGrid): SKU: ["H100_80GB_PCIe_v2"], non-preemptible only. Static egress IPs for their control plane, yes. KMS key will be partner-managed (cross-account).

 julian (Partnerships): @nora note: partner also requested the "dedicated capacity" toggle in the marketplace tile and the option for private VPC provisioning during purchase.

 mira (Solutions): Ops guidance: recommend canary with 2 tenants and 4 GPUs reserved first. Watch p99 latency, memory OOM errors, and GPU temperature throttling. We should also pin model version on listing.

 devin (Legal): Heads-up: if their marketing copy implies "SLA-backed" we need to ensure it matches Redwood Dedicated SLA wording. Also BYOK cross-account adds a compliance attestation requirement.

 nora (Cloud Ops): I'll open infra ticket and marketplace entitlement request. Entitlement JSON we need from partner should include region, sku_ids, reserved_count, burst_capacity, kms_arn, vpc_required, static_ips_count. Example to paste in ticket:
```
{
  "region": "ms-orchid-1",
  "sku_ids": ["H100_80GB_PCIe_v2"],
  "reserved_count": 16,
  "burst_capacity": 16,
  "kms_arn": "arn:aws:kms:...:key/abcd",
  "vpc_required": true,
  "static_ips_count": 2
}
```

 mira (Solutions): Also define fallback: if reserved < requested, route to ms-orchid-2 hosted first, then fallback to eu-central-hosted. Add partner opt-in to fallback or opt-out during listing.

 julian (Partnerships): Let's capture that as a policy: 2 allocation failures within 5 minutes trigger automatic fallback to ms-orchid-2-hosted; notify partner and open CP ticket.

 infra-bot: ticket created: CP-4780 by nora at 1765560005 — link: https://redwood.atlassian.com/browse/CP-4780 — attaching entitlement request.

 nora (Cloud Ops): Provider responded: preliminary capacity commitment = 10/16 non-preempt H100s. Final confirmation pending internal pool rebalancing (ETA 36h). If final < requested, we'll need shortfall plan.

 tomas (LunarGrid): 10 would be tight. Can we get a ramp plan? If 10 locked in, we need to limit listing to 2 tenants with canary and delayed general availability.

 devin (Legal): Please ensure marketplace tile copy has fallback language. Draft clause suggestion: "Reserved capacity subject to provider availability; automatic fallback to hosted variants may apply." I'll post a short T&C blurb here in a minute.

 mira (Solutions): Also remind partner to include test service account creds for QA, and a small synthetic prompt set we can use for regression checks.

 tomas (LunarGrid): I'll upload test creds and prompt set to PR: https://git.redwood/lunargrid/marketplace-onboard-pr (assets + docs).

 nora (Cloud Ops): Added note to CP-4780: require network egress IPs and KMS cross-account policy. Also adding a preflight checklist item for PCI scan because LunarGrid indicated EU payments integration.

 infra-bot: CP-4780 updated by provider (1765560200): preliminary approval 10 H100s; queued for pool allocation.

 julian (Partnerships): If allocation stays at 10, propose we proceed with canary (2 tenants, 4 GPUs each) and schedule follow-up capacity expansion in 2 weeks. Partner and marketing will mark GA tentative until additional capacity is confirmed.

 tomas (LunarGrid): Acceptable. We'll communicate a GA hold to our product team.

 devin (Legal): Posting draft marketplace entitlement language: "LunarGrid dedicated capacity offering is provided subject to Redwood Inference's region capacity and provider availability. Reservations may be partial and temporary fallbacks to hosted offerings may occur. See Redwood Dedicated SLA for details." Feedback welcome.

 mira (Solutions): I'll assemble canary runbook and share metrics dashboard template (p95/p99 latency, 5xx rate, GPU util, token/sec). Will add rollback steps if p99 > 800ms for 3 consecutive minutes.

 nora (Cloud Ops): Noted. CP-4780 ETA for final pool decision 1765563605 (~ 1h). I'll update ticket and ping this thread when final.

 infra-bot: CP-4780 -> provider final decision logged at 1765560300: final allocation = 12/16 H100s approved.

 julian (Partnerships): Good. We have 12 confirmed. Action plan: canary with 2 tenants (8 GPUs reserved), keep 4 GPUs as buffer for burst. Schedule canary 2026-05-06, GA pending extra allocation.

 tomas (LunarGrid): Thanks all. We'll adjust listing to show "limited capacity" and request marketing coordinate teaser only after GA confirmed.

 devin (Legal): I'll finalize entitlement blurb and the marketplace listing checklist with the fallback language.

 julian (Partnerships): Recap action items:
- @tomas: finalize KMS ARN, cross-account policy, test creds, and updated tile copy (EOD).
- @nora: finalize CP-4780 and confirm static IP allocation, update fallback policy in routing config.
- @mira: deliver canary runbook and dashboard template.
- @devin: post final T&C snippet and entitlement blurb.

 infra-bot: CP-4780 set to "pending partner signoff" at 1765560310.

 julian (Partnerships): I'll circle back once partner signs off. Closing thread for now, will reopen on partner ack. :rocket:
